# Automation and Email

Automate work with rules, notifications, email and automation flows.

| Page | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [Automation](automation.md) | Assign documents with Assignment Rule, repeat documents with Auto Repeat, set Reminders, track Milestones, and name documents with Document Naming Rule and Document Naming Settings. |
| [Automation Flow](automation-flow.md) | Run a series of actions when a document changes, on a date, on a schedule or on a custom event, with Automation Flow, runs and Automation Settings. |
| [Notifications](notifications.md) | Send email, in-app, SMS or webhook alerts when documents change, with the Notification DocType, Notification Log and Notification Settings. |
| [Email](email.md) | Set up Email Account and Email Domain, watch the Email Queue, reuse text with Email Template, schedule Auto Email Report, and handle unsubscribes. |
